formatRoles.feed: Verified data, comparisons, checklists and investment analysis with one dominant figure or argument.
formatRoles.story: One timely fact or question with visible source date and a dedicated vertical design.
formatRoles.reel: A 15 to 30 second vertical explanation using one question, up to three verified points and a concise conclusion or CTA.

editorialMethods.audienceDecisionNeeds: Every new content item maps to at least one approved investor, entrepreneur or relocator decision problem.
editorialMethods.hooks: Short direct questions, decision risks, evidence comparisons, myth-versus-fact or evidence-supported unpopular opinions. No viral promises or unsupported certainty.
editorialMethods.trends: Only reviewed, current candidates backed by primary, official or original-study evidence.
editorialMethods.repurposing: Allowed across genuinely different formats when hook, audience value, visual and format role are materially different.
editorialMethods.socialProof: Blocked unless evidence, permission and confidentiality review are recorded.
editorialMethods.performance: CTA and hook preferences may change only after at least three comparable posts and an approved performance learning.
editorialMethods.carousels: Editorial pilot of up to four assets replacing Feed slots, but publishing remains disabled until carousel QA, adapter and live verification are complete.
